contract.mapDefinitionScope: Retained path/area baseline; XYZ faces use 1.6.0 and XYZ paths use existing KML layer documents. No new XYZ-path saved kind.

acceptedBehavior: C01: Editable durable line, path, polygon, circle, absolute XYZ KML path and XYZ face metrics expose units and honest uncertainty. Unknown source accuracy remains unknown; supplied radial/elevation bounds cover only the stated model. Normal-owner compiled XYZ editing preserves exact Z through UI CAS Save, fresh context/server reopen and exact KML export/reparse.

C02: Real-provider saved profiles retain slope, distance, elevation, exact sample coordinates/values and recorded source/query provenance. Fresh hosted reopen preserves profile and LOS/CSV output without terrain resampling.

C03: Real Mapzen elevation passes compiled Catalog/Project 289-cell viewshed Calculate, full portable GeoJSON export and temporary Add, with 0 analysis-added terrain reads. Source/grid, observer/target assumptions, units, tolerance, bounds and classifications are retained. Added cells are visibly temporary and excluded from Project Save.

Exact pinned Google Earth Pro 7.3.7.1327 native controls were exercised for all six types and a saved-path profile. Observed model differences remain disclosed; comparison does not assert numerical agreement.

verification.unitReferenceProfile: Three authored vertices with a deterministic elevation function produce a bounded complete profile whose 3D distance is greater than its 2D distance.
verification.apiReferenceProfile: The API independently recomputes a two-vertex 2D distance and a 10-meter elevation gain within 0.01 meter tolerance.
verification.browserNoDataProfile: The managed renderer fixture returns the terrain no-data sentinel; the browser saves a three-vertex path, reopens it for a four-vertex edit, and persists unavailable elevation, null terrain source, and null 3D summary.
verification.ownerXYZ: 100.49875621123603 m initial; normal XY edit retains exact Z and gives 100.79552876201174 m; UI CAS Save/fresh server+browser reopen/exact 578 B KML reparse pass.
verification.realProviderGrid: 289 cells: 135 visible/153 occluded/1 observer; full analytical export and temporary Add; 0 extra analysis reads. Fixture metadata, not Catalog ingestion.
verification.browserBoundsAndAT: Linux Chromium: 63x63/3,969 cells in 2,362.1 ms; 128 vertices/126 triangles in 44.6 ms. Keyboard calculation/cell inspection, browser labels and 284 native AT-SPI nodes passed.

limitations: Unknown position/provider accuracy is not a survey or estimated error bound. Mean-sphere models and unconverted KML source altitudes can differ from native ellipsoid/terrain results.

Saved measurements: 50/map, 128 vertices/profile samples, 256 KiB native map. XYZ faces: 126 triangles, 100 km extent/100,000 m absolute elevation,1,000 m supplied uncertainty,128 KiB GeoJSON. Absolute KML paths retain existing 10,000-position/source-altitude parser limits.

Cached grid: 63 cells/side, 4M checks/5s, 100 km, 8 MiB GeoJSON. Missing terrain remains unknown; outside-grid areas are unevaluated. No refraction, buildings, vegetation or finer-than-source surface claim.

Browser CORS hides Mapzen ETag/Content-Range; no atomic immutable provider snapshot is claimed. Native Circle export retains a sampled perimeter, not exact centre/radius metadata; proprietary Google full terrain samples/model are unavailable. No same-circle identity or same-provider equivalence claim.

Device/AT/performance evidence covers the observed Linux desktop and declared finite workloads. Other physical devices, representative-user studies and larger-than-supported workflows remain unverified. New UI production delivery remains pending.
